headline: More than 836,000 Americans are without power this Thanksgiving as a massive coast-to-coast storm system batters the country with damaging winds, heavy rain, and record coastal flooding. Just five states account for nearly 87% of all blackouts nationwide, with Virginia, Maryland, and Pennsylvania taking the hardest hits as fierce gusts lash the East Coast. The storm forced the postponement of the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, brought Nashville its first measurable Thanksgiving snowfall in 76 years and unleashed a hurricane-force 81 mph gust along the Jersey Shore.
